en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on pianists
Watch a documentary on detectives
B-Bugs?
It's not like I hate Gonta, but...

It's not really something we should
watch with just the two of us...
When I watch these, I get really pumped...

A performance isn't a competition,
but I refuse to lose...

Alright! I'm gonna practice once I
return to my research lab!
Yeah, let's watch that!

Now I'll get to learn more about your
job, Shuichi!

If I'm ever involved in an incident,
I'll go to you right away...

When that time comes,
I hope you'll take care of me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaede's inner thoughts...?
